title: High power output density organic thermoelectric devices for practical applications in waste heat harvesting
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01045K, Review Article
Xin Hao, Jing Wang, Hong Wang
The state-of-the-art works on developing organic materials with high electrical conductivity and high power factor to improve the power output density of organic thermoelectric generator are summarized in this review.
